description: XSUAA security descriptor for procurement-core - defines the same three roles the local mocked-auth setup uses (package.json's cds.requires.auth.users), so nothing about the RBAC model changes between local dev and a real deployment, only how identity is asserted.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Requester
scopes.description: Can create and submit Purchase Requisitions

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.Approver
scopes.description: Can approve or reject submitted Purchase Requisitions

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.IntegrationAdmin
scopes.description: Can run the legacy-supplier sync integration action

role-collections.name: ProcureIQ Requester
role-collections.description: Business users who raise Purchase Requisitions
